name: Mosquitia District
method: contemporary administrative report, publication-year proxy
locator: Guía de Honduras, printed p. 135, Distrito de la Mosquitia, Población and División.
definition: The 1905 guide gives the population of the Mosquitia district of Colón, comprising the municipalities of Aguán and Iriona. The date and collection method are unspecified. This observation gives no 1901 census count or allocation across the frontier settled by the 1906 award.
